pages: Lumi was a brave little firefly. Lumi loved to shine! Tonight, the meadow was dark. Very, very dark. All the fireflies were out, but something was wrong. The sparkle was gone! The fireflies usually twinkled, but tonight, their lights were just… dim. A magical mystery needs solving! Lumi felt a little scared. Lumi took a deep breath. In, and out. Like smelling flowers. Lumi felt a little better. Lumi is brave and kind, so Lumi knew what to do. "I will find the sparkle!" said Lumi.

Lumi flew past a big, red poppy. "Poppy, do you know where the sparkle went?" The poppy didn't answer. Lumi flew over a patch of bluebells. "Bluebells, do you know where the sparkle went?" The bluebells didn't answer either. Lumi felt a little sad. All the colors felt dull! Then Lumi saw something! A tiny, shimmering dust cloud near the stream. The dust was sparkly! But it was stuck. Stuck on a tiny pebble. Lumi flew closer. Closer! Lumi pushed the sparkly dust. It was hard! But Lumi kept pushing. All the fireflies watched.

Lumi pushed and pushed! With one last wiggle and push, the sparkly dust floated free! It spread out, covering the whole meadow. Suddenly, all the fireflies began to twinkle again! The meadow was bright and beautiful. The sparkle was back! Lumi smiled. Lumi realized something. Lumi didn’t need a special tool. Lumi had their own bright light! Lumi used it to show the other fireflies how to get their sparkles back! It turned out that the sparkle was stuck in their own lights. By shining extra brightly to push the sparkle to the pebble, Lumi freed the sparkle from all the fireflies. Now, Lumi is known as **The Brave Little Firefly**!
